name: BBQ Salmon OR Trout
description: Salmon or trout fillets marinated in onion soup mix and Clamato juice, grilled to perfection in foil.
recipeIngredient: 2 large fillets of salmon or trout
Citrus and pepper seasoning (e.g., Club House brand)

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse and clean the fillets. Place skin side down on aluminum foil.
Sprinkle the contents of the onion soup mix evenly over the fillets.
Add butter on top of the fillets.
Squeeze the juice of ½ lemon over the fillets and slice the remaining ½ for garnish.
Add citrus and pepper seasoning to taste.
Pour Clamato juice over the fillets.
Wrap the foil over the fillets, sealing the seams tightly.
Cook on a barbecue on medium-high heat on the bottom rack for 25 to 30 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

keywords: BBQ salmon, BBQ trout, grilled fish, Clamato juice marinade

_similar.name: Baked Striped Bass (Or White Fish)
_similar.description: A whole striped bass or white fish baked with garlic, mushrooms, and herbs, served with a rich butter sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 to 4 lb whole striped bass, dressed and boned

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F and lightly butter a large, shallow baking pan.
Wash and pat dry the fish with paper towels. Sprinkle inside and outside with salt and pepper.
Place the fish in the baking pan and add the remaining ingredients except for the sauce ingredients.
Bake, basting frequently with the liquid in the pan, for 40 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Carefully remove the fish to a heated serving platter, cover, and keep warm.
To make the sauce, cook the pan liquid over medium heat until it reduces to 1 cup, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Blend 1 teaspoon of butter with flour and stir into the hot liquid. Bring to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat and add the remaining butter, shaking the pan until melted. Remove from heat.
Serve the sauce with the fish.

_similar.keywords: baked fish, striped bass, white fish, herb butter sauce
